The main takeaway from our work is that

the t-channel pole is a robust property of scattering amplitud es at high energies, and can be used to construct a description of hard, r adiative corrections which is free from large logarithms of energy.

the t-channel poles are the only singularities of the scattering amplitudes that are relevant to the calculation of multi-jet rates, as long as we restrict ourselves to the leading power in the strong coupling constant.
the t-channel poles in qQ and q g amplitudes are not independent of each other.
